visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor locker room environment with soft lighting. Two young men in navy and yellow e-sports jerseys are engaged in an emotional moment; one is slumped forward with his eyes closed, while the other places a steadying hand on his shoulder. (2) Scene shifts to a man in a blue suit and glasses gesturing emphatically as he speaks to a semi-circle of players in the same jerseys, his expression serious and motivating. (3) The entire team and staff cluster together, stacking their hands in the center for a synchronized motivational gesture before a match. (4) Transition to a high-contrast cinematic stage environment where players sit at illuminated gaming stations with headsets; the coach stands behind them, clapping and shouting encouragement. (5) Digital screen capture of a mobile MOBA game (Arena of Valor) displays intense combat sequences, ability effects in purple and gold, and text notifications for player kills. (6) Visual cut to a large stadium crowd with fans wearing team jerseys, jumping and raising their arms in celebration. (7) Backstage in a more private setting, a player speaks directly to someone off-camera, his face showing a mix of tension and hope. (8) On the main stage, players are seen celebrating, jumping out of their seats, and high-fiving each other under bright, moving spotlights. (9) A player and the coach share a tight, celebratory hug in front of computer monitors. (10) A wide drone-like view shows a packed arena filled with fans waving white glow sticks and team banners. (11) Four players stand on a central podium, lifting a large gold trophy together as digital fire and confetti effects fill the background; large text on screen reads 2025 SUMMER CHAMPION. (12) A player walks through a hallway, speaking with a slight smile and relaxed posture, looking toward the camera as he reflects on the victory.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 6 main players/coach, multiple staff members, and a large crowd of fans in the stadium.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Young Asian males wearing navy, white, and yellow 'Flash Wolves' branded e-sports jerseys; one older male in a professional blue suit and glasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a functional locker room with wooden cabinets and motivational posters, a dimly lit backstage area with equipment, and a massive professional e-sports arena featuring giant LED screens and theatrical lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with a mid-tempo cinematic synth bed and a male voice speaking in a calm, encouraging tone. No sharp SFX present. (2) A sharp transition introduces a louder, more authoritative male voice (coach) delivering a speech with high vocal tension and rising intonation; the BGM swells with added orchestral strings and a driving drum beat. (3) A sudden burst of high-arousal group shouting ("閃電狼!") occurs, followed by rhythmic hand-clapping and the sound of a crowded room. (4) The audio texture shifts to high-frequency game sounds (digital zaps and UI clicks) layered over fast-paced male commentary that exhibits high speech density. (5) A wave of intense crowd noise, including high-pitched screaming and sustained applause, dominates the mix for several seconds as the BGM reaches a triumphant peak. (6) A quiet vocal pause features a low-volume male whisper before a massive percussive impact SFX signals a scene change. (7) Final phase features a relaxed, mid-pitch male narrative voice over a fading melodic synth pad, concluding with a soft ambient room tone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To celebrate the victory and championship win of the e-sports team 'Flash Wolves' by highlighting emotional backstage moments, intense gameplay, and the triumphant trophy ceremony to inspire and engage their fanbase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Visible team jerseys featuring Red Bull logos and team-specific branding; players using specific gaming peripherals.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High production value montage using synchronous audio-visual cues to maximize emotional impact. The video effectively bridges the gap between the private emotional struggle and the public glory of competitive gaming.
